g.text: n=m=48, polynomial; paper rule first N: k=0 in 32/32
CE: chosen order grows with sample size
Lines/bands: chosen-order medians/IQR; k=0 is a valid threshold outcome. Dotted line: dense order n.
Post hoc fixed order includes dense and is not available to the learner. All plotted rules have 0/32 policy failures at each N.
